sources.title: Best Way to Run Qwen 3.6 35B MoE Locally: VRAM, Speed, Setup
sources.snippet: You pay memory like a 35B and compute like a 3B. That asymmetry is the whole MoE pitch. As of 2026-10-07 there is no official Qwen 3.8 35B-A3B: the model circulating under that name is empero-ai/Qwen3.8-35B-A3B-Distill, a third-party distill that Empero released on 2026-09-16 by fine-tuning this Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B on Qwen 3.8 outputs.
